import { Aside } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

The **Marketplace** is a public registry where you publish an agent, fork one someone else published, or invoke it without forking. **A2A** (Agent-to-Agent) is an open protocol for agents to find and call each other, and an **agent card** is the public description an agent publishes. A **fork** is your private copy of a published agent: the original author sees none of your data or runs. Other platforms can call your public agents through A2A without ever sharing your tenant.

## Two registries

The dashboard Marketplace (`/marketplace`) fronts two registries.

| Registry | Endpoint | What you do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Agent Marketplace | `/v1/marketplace` | Filter by category or search text; star, fork, or unpublish your own. Listings carry a description, tags, README, star and fork counts. |
| MCP Marketplace | `/v1/mcp/servers` | Browse a curated registry of Model Context Protocol servers. Attach one with `POST /v1/agents/{name}/mcp-servers`. |

## Publish an agent

Publishing copies the agent's manifest into the public registry under a slug. There is no review queue and no unlisted mode: the listing is live when the call returns.

```http
POST /v1/marketplace/publish
{
  "agentName": "research-agent",
  "description": "Cited research reports",
  "category": "research",
  "tags": ["research", "web"],
  "readme": "..."
}

DELETE /v1/marketplace/{slug}     # unpublish
```

It returns `{ id, slug, url }`. The slug is `<your-tenant-slug>-<agent-name>`.

<Aside type="caution">
Any signed-in tenant can read a published agent's manifest, including its system prompt (`GET /v1/marketplace` and `/{slug}` return 401 without auth). The public A2A card needs no auth. Do not put secrets in a manifest. Use `lantern.secret/...` refs (the ref prefix keeps its original name), which each tenant resolves from its own store at run time.
</Aside>

## Discover and fork

```http
GET  /v1/marketplace?category=research&q=citations
GET  /v1/marketplace/{slug}                 # manifest, card, README
POST /v1/marketplace/{slug}/fork            { "newName": "my-copy" }
POST /v1/marketplace/{slug}/star
```

Fork returns `{ agentId, agentName }`. A fork is a normal agent in your tenant: edit its prompt, swap models, add connectors, and the original is unaffected.

## Invoke without forking

A buyer can invoke a published agent without forking it. The run executes in the **seller's** tenant, with their LLM keys and budgets. The seller's hard-fail budget applies (HTTP 402), and the buyer's input is validated against the manifest's `inputSchema` when one exists. The buyer gets the output and an HMAC-SHA256 signed receipt.

```http
POST /v1/marketplace/{slug}/invoke
{ "input": { "topic": "..." } }

GET /v1/marketplace/invocations?role=buyer    # buyer-side history
GET /v1/marketplace/invocations?role=seller   # seller-side history
```

Invoke returns `{ invocationId, status, output, costUsd, signature, sellerTenantId, agentName, issuedAt, receipt }`. The `receipt` object carries invocationId, buyerTenant, sellerTenant, marketplace, agentName, runId, costUsd, issuedAt, signature and algorithm.

| Status | When |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | Input fails the manifest's `inputSchema` |
| 402 | Seller budget reached |
| 404 | Unknown slug |
| 502 | The seller run failed |
| 503 | Execution unavailable |

## Expose an agent over A2A

Agents are **private by default** (`agents.is_public = false`). The card, the well-known directory and A2A invoke expose an agent to a non-owner only when it is public.

```http
GET /v1/agents/{name}/card          # own agent or is_public; else 404
GET /.well-known/agent.json         # lists only public agents
POST /v1/agents/{name}/a2a/invoke   # authenticated callers only; 401 without credentials
```

- An authenticated caller always sees and can invoke their **own** agents, whatever the visibility.
- A card or invoke for another tenant's non-public agent returns **404**, not 403, so the agent's existence does not leak.
- Other platforms discover agents through `/.well-known/agent.json` and `/v1/agents/{name}/card`.
- Inside a running agent, `ctx.a2a(agentCardUrl).submit({ input })` calls a remote A2A agent through the runtime sidecar, and `ctx.subagent(name, input)` calls another agent by name. The outbound A2A call works in the production runtime only; the Python `AgentContext` stub raises `NotImplementedError`.

## Limits

- **No endpoint sets `is_public`.** Today it is a column on `agents` that an operator flips.
- **No public verifier for invocation receipts.** Verifying one needs the platform signing key.
- **No `pal marketplace` command.** The Python SDK has `client.marketplace`.
- **No review queue** and no unlisted mode for published agents.
